audience_profile: Senior engineers who ship releases and want to see how a very large launch avoids one traffic spike.
learning_objective: Three launch techniques (pre-load, staggered unlock, deltas) and the one dependency that cannot be pre-loaded.
creative_concept: A launch-control room in neon lines: one story from 212 GB to the single point of failure, ending on a save-worthy pipeline.

treatments.name: A. Launch-control diagrams with two 3D shots
treatments.shape: counter + map, timeline, CDN network (3D), traffic graph, rolling globe (3D), chunk grid, gate, cards, pipeline

treatments.name: B. Talking points over stock footage
C. One long diagram
treatments.shape: single pipeline built step by step

chosen: A. Launch-control diagrams with two 3D shots
hook: 212 GB counts up; at 00:00 every console fires at one server.
narrative_structure: The problem; three techniques; the dependency that can't be pre-loaded; the lesson; the pipeline to save.
visual_direction: midnight-launch: night navy-purple, orange, pink and teal neon lines; no game art, no logos.
narration_approach: Calm and precise; numbers spoken naturally; PS5 as 'P S five'.

scene_breakdown.title: 212 GB at midnight
scene_breakdown.purpose: 212 GB counts up; console dots light across a dark map; 00:00; every dot fires at one server, which turns red and shakes

scene_breakdown.title: Preload window
scene_breakdown.purpose: A Nov 10-19 preload window fills day by day; a midnight spike vs the same bytes spread over the window

scene_breakdown.title: CDN
scene_breakdown.purpose: Blender: one origin, edge caches around it, then short local hops to players

scene_breakdown.title: Comcast record
scene_breakdown.purpose: A traffic line climbs off the top of the chart; 'largest single event in its network history' (Comcast)

scene_breakdown.title: Rolling midnight
scene_breakdown.purpose: Blender globe: an orange local-midnight band sweeps west from New Zealand; regions light in turn

scene_breakdown.title: Deltas
scene_breakdown.purpose: A 212 GB block of chunks; only the changed chunks glow and ship as a 1.07 GB patch

scene_breakdown.title: Licence check
scene_breakdown.purpose: A fully downloaded console waits at the licence gate while PSN is disrupted; offline play is the exception

scene_breakdown.title: The lesson
scene_breakdown.purpose: Three numbered lessons; card 3 links back to the red licence gate

scene_breakdown.title: Pipeline
scene_breakdown.purpose: Save-worthy pipeline: build & release, origin, CDN edges, preload window, rolling unlock, licence check (single point of failure), player

decisions.reason: User's choice; an original control-room look, not the game's style.

decisions.choice: two Blender shots: CDN network, rolling-midnight globe
decisions.reason: Depth explains distribution and time zones.

decisions.choice: public facts only; techniques framed generally
decisions.reason: Rockstar has not published its infrastructure.

decisions.choice: no game art, logos or footage

decisions.reason: A different transition on every cut.

dropoff.countermeasure: A console visibly waits at a red gate

experiment: Does a news hook framed as an engineering question hold senior viewers?
effects_reason: 2D diagrams (dev_scene) for most lines; two blender3d shots (a treatment, not a motion effect) where depth explains.
